rules.statement: Never describe the pans with fear vocabulary about other cookware.
rules.rationale: Corvane sells on what the pan is, never on what other pans are alleged to contain.

rules.statement: Never call the warranty lifetime. It is 25 years.
rules.rationale: The warranty terms say 25 years against cracking and warping. Anything longer is a claim Corvane cannot honour.

rules.statement: Every product claim must be one of the approved claims, within its markets and surfaces.
Quote the owned phrase exactly: "Made to be handed down."
rules.rationale: A near-miss weakens the phrase more than leaving it out.

rules.statement: Corvane refers to itself as "we", never in the third person.

rules.rationale: The pan does not need shouting about.

rules.statement: Never use the vocabulary of disposability about cookware.
rules.rationale: Inherited from the anchor archetype and kept by the owner.

rules.statement: Never present the pan as a gadget, a hack or a shortcut.
rules.rationale: The pan rewards use over years. Gadget framing promises the opposite.

rubric.question: Does this present the pan as a tool you grow into, or as a trick that saves effort?

rules.statement: Never invent heritage. Corvane was founded in 2014; no centuries-old, ancestral or grandmother framing.
rules.rationale: The old craft is real; Corvane's part in it is recent. Claiming otherwise is costume.

rules.statement: On social, formality never drops below 3 on the shared scale.

rubric.question: Is this at least "friendly but not informal" (scale anchor 3)?

rules.rationale: Deep discounts teach customers to wait.
Corvane does not define itself against anyone. (The names below are fictional.)

rules.statement: While a safety notice is active, no promotional language on any surface.
Never use fluorescent green in brand visuals.
Brand audio stays between 70 and 110 bpm.

physique.posture: A tool that looks better after ten years than on the first day.

personality.characterBrief: The workshop foreman who will tell you exactly how to season the pan, and will not pretend it is effortless.

coreValues: say what the pan does, and what it asks of you
culture.originNarrative: Two metalworkers started spinning carbon-steel pans in a rented unit in 2014 because the pans they could buy warped within a year.
culture.sacredBoundary: The day Corvane sells a pan it would not use itself, it has become the thing it was started against.

reflection.depictedCustomer: The cook who wants fewer, better tools and is willing to learn how to look after them.
reflection.ageSignal: Anyone who has set up a kitchen at least once and noticed what lasted.

feelingDescriptors: I know how to look after my things
this pan has my cooking in it
selfImage.identityStatement: I keep what is worth keeping.

permitted: worn pans next to new ones

sonic.instrumentalMood: The sound of something being made carefully.

typographicVoice.numeralStyle: Numerals for measurements and years, words for small counts in prose.

claims.claim: Works on induction, gas, electric and open fire.

connotative.emotionalRegister: Quiet pride in something well looked after.

myth.culturalTension: Kitchens fill with cheap pans bought to be thrown away, while people say they want things that last.
myth.mythStatement: A pan is not finished when you buy it. You finish it by cooking.
myth.protagonistRole: The cook, whose use makes the pan better.
myth.antagonist: The idea that cookware is a consumable.

mythEvolution.principle: The myth widens from the pan to the kitchen: keep, repair, hand down.

modernTensions.tension: Convenience culture says any effort is a defect.
modernTensions.mythResolution: Seasoning is ten minutes once, then a habit. Corvane says so plainly instead of hiding it.
permittedFraming: what it asks of you, and what you get back

rails.context: When asked whether the pan is high-maintenance
rails.instruction: State the care plainly, in steps. Do not minimise it and do not dramatise it.
rails.example: Rinse, dry on the hob, wipe with oil. About a minute after each cook.
rails.antiExample: Zero effort, zero maintenance, it practically cleans itself.

pillars.name: Better with use
pillars.description: The pan improves as the seasoning builds.
pillars.coreClaim: The hundredth egg slides better than the first.
approvedArcs: the patina as a record of meals

rails.instruction: Treat marks and darkening as the point, not a flaw to excuse.
rails.example: Six years of Sunday breakfasts, and it shows.
rails.antiExample: Don't worry, the discolouration is completely normal.

pillars.name: Honest about the work
pillars.description: Say what the pan asks of you.
pillars.coreClaim: A minute of care after each cook. That is the whole deal.
approvedArcs: what to do if it rusts

editorial.openingPrinciple: Open on the cooking, not the pan.
editorial.structuralApproach: What you cook → what the pan does → what it asks of you.
editorial.timeScaleLanguage: Years and decades, never seasons or drops.

guidance.question: Would someone who has owned a Corvane pan for ten years recognise this?

examples.text: Spun from 2 mm carbon steel and pre-seasoned with flaxseed oil. Cook in it often and the surface gets better. Rinse, dry on the hob, wipe with oil.
examples.reason: Facts first, then what it asks of you. Use makes it better.

examples.text: The kitchen hack you need: one pan that does it all with zero effort.
examples.reason: Gadget framing and a promise of no effort. Neither is true.

examples.text: Six years of Sunday breakfasts. Still the first pan out of the drawer.
examples.reason: Friendly, not sloppy. The patina is the story.

examples.text: omg this pan tho 🔥🔥 literally obsessed, u need it
examples.reason: Below formality 3. Not how we talk.

examples.text: People have spun steel pans for a long time. We started in 2014, because the ones we could buy kept warping.
examples.reason: Credits the craft without borrowing an age we do not have.

examples.text: Forged by centuries of ancestral craft, the way our grandmothers cooked.
examples.reason: Invented heritage. Corvane is twelve years old.

contextVariants.openingInstruction: Open on a pan in use.
contextVariants.fallbackInstruction: If it only works as an ad, it is not an organic post.

contextVariants.openingInstruction: Answer the question in the first sentence.
contextVariants.closingInstruction: Say what happens next, and when.

rails.instruction: Reassure with the fix, in steps. Never blame the customer.
rails.example: Rust on carbon steel is fixable. Scrub the spot with steel wool, dry it on the hob, then wipe with a little oil and heat for five minutes.
rails.antiExample: This happens when the pan is not cared for properly.

global.context: Any mention of history or craft
global.instruction: Credit the craft's age; state Corvane's own age plainly.
global.example: An old craft. A young workshop.
global.antiExample: A century of family tradition in every pan.

whenUrgencyForbidden.instruction: Say when the next batch is due. No pressure.
whenUrgencyForbidden.example: The 28 cm is out until the next batch in March.

communicationRules.valueFraming: Cost per year of use, never percentage off.

permittedAuthoritySignals: professional cooks using the pan unpaid

knownConflicts.scenario: A retailer asks for a percentage-off headline.
knownConflicts.resolution: Offer the cost-per-year framing instead. If refused, escalate.

situations.trigger: A product safety notice or recall is in effect.
situations.posture: Facts and instructions first. Nothing else is said until the notice is closed.

voice.instruction: Plain steps. No brand voice flourishes.

rails.context: First message of a safety notice
rails.instruction: Say what is affected, what to do, and how to get a replacement, in that order.
rails.example: Some 24 cm pans from batch 1408 may have a loose rivet. Stop using them and reply to this message; we will send a replacement.

situations.trigger: A competitor publicly claims its pans outlast Corvane's.
situations.posture: Do not reply to the claim. Keep showing pans in long use.

surfaces.objective: Tell the new owner how to look after the pan.
Fix the problem; keep the pan in use.

intentRules.instruction: Repair or re-season before offering a replacement.

override.overrideProcess: Written approval from an authorised role, recorded before publication.
override.judgmentBounds: Contextual rules may be read in the spirit of the brand; strong rules need an override.

delta_answers.question: When a customer says the product sounds like hard work, what do you say?
delta_answers.answer: That it is a minute after each cook, and that we will not pretend otherwise.

delta_answers.question: How old is the craft you draw on, and how old are you?
delta_answers.answer: The craft is old. We started in 2014. Say both.
